findings.text: Perfect execution across all items: 100% completion rate with zero failures, all tests passing, and consistent Hermes approvals indicate strong code quality and effective acceptance criteria definition.

Three consecutive title styling iterations (colorful → cohesive → premium) were completed in rapid succession (within ~37 seconds), suggesting either iterative refinement of a single feature or quick pivots based on feedback.

Consider consolidating related UI styling items into a single epic before sprint planning to reduce version churn; the three title updates could have been batched as one comprehensive styling task rather than three separate deployments.

Consistent documentation practices: all items include detailed changelog entries, matching version numbers across files, and proper deployment timestamps, demonstrating disciplined release management.

retros.summary: Sprint achieved perfect health with 3/3 items completed, zero defects, and all tests passing—strong execution though rapid consecutive iterations suggest potential for improved requirement batching.
